dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible, characterized by irregular, high-contrast light perimeters. These structures exhibit a sharp pixel gradient transition from the darker exterior background to the lighter interior of the perimeter ring. The edges are non-uniform and jagged.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-intensity pixel clusters is present along the mid-lateral and posterior-dorsal surfaces. These clusters lack internal gradients and show high core pixel concentration.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the dorsal-mid region form an obtuse scalene triangle. This triangular structure, when linked to the centroids of the posterior blob clusters, forms an irregular polygonal network across the lateral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized cluster of high-intensity yellow pixels is present on the dorsal surface of the snout.
